title: UDGAMA 2026
venue: Chalapathi University, Guntur & Lakireddy Bali Reddy College of Engineering, Mylavaram
theme: Empowering Future Engineers Through Innovation, Leadership and IEEE Excellence
summary: UDGAMA 2026, the IEEE Guntur Subsection Student Congress, was held on 7–8 August 2026 across Chalapathi University and Lakireddy Bali Reddy College of Engineering. The two-day congress brought together engineering students and the IEEE community for keynote sessions, technical competitions, innovation showcases, leadership development and professional networking.
description: IEEE UDGAMA 2026 – Guntur Subsection Student Congress was organized by the IEEE Hyderabad Section Student Activities Committee in collaboration with the IEEE Guntur Subsection. Day 1, hosted at Chalapathi University, Mothadaka, Guntur, focused on foundational technologies, core hardware and startup ideation, with keynote sessions, a leadership panel, a research poster competition, an innovation project expo, and an innovation challenge and startup pitch. Day 2, hosted at Lakireddy Bali Reddy College of Engineering, Mylavaram, focused on advanced 6G and emerging AI applications with keynote sessions, a panel discussion, and poster, ideation, design, and coding competitions.
outcomes: Exposure to AI, IoT, electronics, robotics, communication systems, power systems, healthcare technologies, 6G and data-oriented emerging technologies
Research poster and project showcase opportunities
Networking among students, IEEE volunteers, academicians, researchers and industry professionals
